I visited their new upcoming project on 22 Dec 2025. They are charging Rs 1.40 crores for a 2bhk flat with an area of 825 sq ft. How can a builder quote such a maddening price for a flat located in Vasai Gaon? This is unacceptable. Why will one buy a flat worth 1.40 crores in Vasai gaon whereas one can buy a flat in Borivali, Thane or Navi Mumbai in the same price. This is really a joke. The builder thinks that people who come to buy the flats are idiots.

Responding to the reply from the builder:

No amount of amenities can justify the rate you are quoting. You can't build an apartment with amenities in a desert and sell it for a price worth gold. It just doesn't make sense. Amenities matter when the location is right. For a flat in a village, you are quoting 1.5 CR. This amounts to fraud. No one will buy your flats unless you reduce the price. I won't even buy your flat for 50 lakhs. It's not even worth that amount. I think 25 lakhs is the max that you should quote for a flat in an isolated, underdeveloped and shady place like Vasai gaon
